extracted.name: Horseradish Dipping Sauce
extracted.description: This spicy sour cream horseradish sauce is great for dipping almost anything worth dipping: Chips, vegetables, seafood — really, anything!
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup prepared horseradish, or to taste
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, stir together sour cream, horseradish, and lemon juice. Season with salt, paprika, garlic salt, and minced onion. Mix and then chill for about 20 minutes to let the flavors blend before you start dipping.
